name: B47ANCED PC Framework

features.text: Standalone Windows 93 desktop, trusted Lua app registry, powered-device checks and reusable server-owned media bindings.
One approved B47/CRT93 desktop and Start menu for all available apps, original pixel icons, retained app/tool taskbar windows, paged catalogs and isolated CD provider selection; offline tested.
Runs without Quartermaster; hosts its registered ledger/CD Writer app through callback contracts.
All powered vanilla PC orientations and other placed Computer-tagged tiles; access, electricity and server authority checks retained.

PC access from occupied native furniture directly in front, including while resting; shared facing/loaded-seat/barrier validation and no forced walking or rest queue edits. Native SP/dedicated pending.
Public UI API 1 and drawing-assets API 1: reusable native PC controls, one hosted app window, palette, scalable/custom icons, layout/focus and lifecycle guards.
Additive installed-app registration and capability query; opt-in Component Gallery consumer; legacy media API 1 retained.
Public nested tabs, wrapping action toolbars and font-sized status bars, demonstrated in the opt-in local gallery and tested offline.

CD program API 1: physical-media descriptor registration, explicit authorized EXE launch, server list/authorize/resolve, exact identity/version checks and opt-in client/server examples. Private snapshots stay server-side; no burning or code loaded from CDs.

Bundled Minesweeper: server-owned disposable board, sequenced legal intents, bounded boredom/unhappiness relief, native owner stat sync and server sandbox controls. No shared scores, items or persisted puzzle.
Feature roadmap proposes arbitrary window drag/snap, richer UI controls and provider dashboards; shared mail/notes, repairs and remote control remain separate authority/API design work.

limits: Native SP/dedicated NOT TESTED for 0.8.0-dev.1. G7/stable G8 BLOCKED. One SDK content window per app; retained app/tool windows share the CRT surface; no independent drag/snap; no Workshop item. UI assets and callback guards grant no gameplay authority; roadmap proposals are not implemented.
